definitions: A group of volcanic islands in the Pacific Ocean, west of Ecuador, known for their unique and diverse plant and animal life.
The Galapagos Islands are famous for their role in Charles Darwin's theory of evolution by natural selection.
examples: The Galapagos are a popular destination for ecotourism.
Many endemic species can be found in the Galapagos.
Darwin visited the Galapagos on his voyage aboard the HMS Beagle.
